Disabling infer_dimensions skips the decode step and still produces content

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_images\":true,\"infer_dimensions\":false}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>No dims: <img src=\"data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8/5+hHgAHggJ/PchI7wAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==\" alt=\"pixel\"></p>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
